# One line per row: what is typed before Tab, then "|" where the cursor
# stands. A line that names a command the tree does not have yet ends in a
# tab and "waits <command>": run.sh skips it, and the Go test TestShellLines
# fails once the command is there, so that the line is made active.
#
# The commands
headscale |
headscale ve|
headscale api |
headscale debug h|
headscale completion |
headscale completion z|
headscale completion bash |
# Flags: long names only on a lone dash, a short typed in full completes
headscale -|
headscale version -|
headscale version --|
headscale version -c|
headscale api whoami --|
# Values, also in the --x= form
headscale -o |
headscale -o=|
headscale --output=j|
headscale debug health -o |
headscale version --output=|
# Files for a path flag
headscale -c |
headscale --config=|
headscale version --config |
# A flag given once is not offered again
headscale -o json -c x debug health --|
headscale version -o json --|
# The word after a value flag is its value
headscale -c -o |
headscale -c x ve|
# After a mistake Tab goes on from the last command understood, never files
headscale nodez |
headscale versoin --|
headscale version --bogus --|
headscale completion bash -c|
# The list flags and their columns, on users list
headscale users |
headscale users list --|
headscale users list --columns id,na|
headscale users list --columns +lo|
headscale users list --sort -co|
headscale users list --filter=pro|
headscale users set alice --|
# Help and --version are ordinary flags on Tab
headscale -h ve|
headscale --version |
# Lines of the commands to come
headscale no|
headscale nodes |
headscale nodes routes ap|
headscale -c x no|
headscale nodes list --|
headscale nodes list -o |
headscale nodes list --columns |
headscale nodes list --columns id,na|
headscale nodes list --columns=id,na|
headscale nodes list --columns id,|
headscale nodes list --sort la|
headscale nodes list --sort -la|
headscale nodes list --filter=ow|
headscale policy set |	waits policy set
headscale check config |	waits check config
headscale nodes list |
headscale nodes delete |
headscale nodes rm --f|
headscale nodes list -o=|
headscale auth keys create alice --tags tag:p|	waits auth keys create
headscale auth keys create alice --tags tag:ci,tag:p|	waits auth keys create
headscale nodes list --config |
headscale nodes list --config=|
headscale nodes set 12 --name |
headscale nodes routes |
headscale nodes list --s|
headscale nodes list -|
headscale nodes list -c|
headscale nodes list --bogus --l|
headscale policy set --bogus |	waits policy set
headscale nodes list --sort id --s|
headscale nodes list --filter id --f|
headscale nodes delete o |
headscale nodes routes set 12 -- --|
headscale nodes list --filter -ow|
headscale nodes list --columns id,-ho|
